blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Photographic color grading shapes the tone and color of a photograph to achieve a desired look. Text-driven photographic look transfer lets users specify these adjustments in natural language, with the goal of reproducing the requested look across photographs while preserving their content. However, prior research on text-driven color grading uses different datasets, text instructions, target definitions, and metrics. These differences make it difficult to compare how faithfully the methods reproduce the same look. To compare methods under a shared protocol, we introduce LUTBench. We collect 91 three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) and define one photographic look per LUT with a specified input conversion. Applying these looks to 5,000 MIT-Adobe FiveK photographs produces 455,000 input-target image pairs with reproducible target images. For each look, we use templates to turn measured tone and color changes on fixed color samples into candidate clauses. We use training image measurements to verify applicable clauses before composing the text description. The evaluation measures target fidelity, tests sensitivity to predefined input conversions, and separates generalization to unseen looks from reproduction of seen looks on new photographs. Across 16 methods, stronger text alignment does not guarantee target fidelity. However, most supervised variants improve fidelity on both seen and unseen looks.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: To apply the same look to a photo series, a photographer might write, “Warm the highlights, reduce chroma in blue regions, and lift the shadows.” A text-driven color grading method must reproduce these adjustments as the subjects and initial colors vary across photographs. Text-conditioned tone adjustment [ 17 , 23 ] , instruction-based image editing [ 1 , 18 ] , and retouching agents [ 8 , 12 ] can all turn such requests into edited photographs.
blocks.zh: 摄影师可能会写到“暖和亮点,减少蓝色区域的铬, 文字驱动的颜色分级方法必须复制这些调整,因为主体和初始颜色因照片而异。 文本有条件的音调调整[17,23],基于指令的图像编辑[1,18],以及重修代理[8,12]都能够将这种请求转化为编辑的照片.

blocks.en: However, prior research uses different test protocols, with variation in datasets, text instructions, target definitions, and metrics. For text-conditioned tone adjustment, one protocol measures text alignment and structure preservation using manually collected tone descriptions and separately compares edited images with filter-rendered targets [ 17 ] . In general instruction editing, a dataset provides manually annotated targets for a broader range of edits [ 42 ] . Work on instruction-guided color grading measures perceptual similarity to LUT-rendered targets and reports model-based preference rankings [ 22 ] . Some prior research reports results on study-specific test sets without making the full evaluation data publicly available [ 4 , 12 , 22 , 35 , 36 ] . Because these protocols measure different aspects of edit quality, direct comparison requires a shared benchmark with the same look, input photographs, target definition, and metrics.
blocks.zh: 然而,之前的研究使用不同的测试协议,在数据集,文本指令,目标定义,和度量衡上都有差异. 对于文字条件的音调调整,一个协议使用人工收集的音调描述来测量文本的对齐和结构保存,并单独比较经编辑的图像与过滤后交付的目标[17]. 在一般指令编辑中,一个数据集为更广泛的编辑提供了手动附加说明的目标[42]. 开展指导性色彩分级测量与LUT授予的目标的感知相似性工作,并报告基于模型的偏好排名[22]. 一些先前的调查报告对具体研究的成套测试结果没有公布完整的评价数据[4、12、22、35、36]。 因为这些协议测量编辑质量的不同方面,直接比较需要有一个具有相同外观,输入照片,目标定义,以及度量衡的共享基准.

blocks.en: When text-driven color grading methods receive the same text description for different photographs, assessing how faithfully they reproduce the requested look requires a target image for each input. Even when two outputs match the requested direction of an adjustment, the magnitude of the change can vary widely. If a fixed color transformation defines the requested look, applying it to each input photograph gives the corresponding target image.
blocks.zh: 当文本驱动的色彩分级方法为不同照片获得相同的文本描述时,评估它们如何忠实地复制所请求的外观需要每个输入的目标图像. 即使两项产出符合要求的调整方向,变化的程度也可能大不相同。 如果一个固定的颜色转换定义了所要求的外观,应用到每个输入照片上给出相应的目标图像.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce LUTBench, a benchmark for text-driven photographic look transfer. We define each look with a three-dimensional lookup table (3D LUT) and a canonical input conversion that maps each photograph to the LUT’s selected input encoding. Applying the LUT to the converted photograph renders its canonical target image, as shown in Fig. 1 . In each comparison, we use a shared evaluation protocol with the same photographs and target image sets for all methods and the same description per look for text-driven methods.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了LUT Bench,这是文本驱动照片外观传输的基准. 我们用一个三维检索表(3D LUT)和一个能将每张照片映射到 LUT 选定的输入编码的犬形输入转换来定义每个外观. 如图1所示,将LUT应用到已转换的照片上使其犬形目标图像变得像. 在每次比较中,我们使用一个共享的评价协议,对所有方法都具有相同的照片和目标图像集,对文本驱动方法的每次搜索都有相同描述.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We collect 91 3D LUTs and define one photographic look per LUT using a canonical input conversion. Applying these looks to 5,000 photographs produces 455,000 input-target image pairs. We construct measurement-based look descriptions from quantified tone and color changes. • We define a protocol that keeps similar LUT transformations in the same partition and uses reproducible target images to assess seen-look reproduction and unseen-look generalization. Paired comparisons of canonical error and minimum error over candidate input conversions test sensitivity to the conversion settings. • We evaluate 16 methods from prior research through zero-shot text-driven configurations, supervised variants, and a reference-guided configuration. We compare target fidelity and assess its link to semantic alignment.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们收集了91个立体LUT,并用犬形输入转换法定义了每个LUT一个照片外观. 将这些外观应用到5000张照片上,会产生455,000个输入目标图像对. 从量化的语气和颜色变化中构建基于测量的外观描述。 我们定义了一个协议,将类似的 LUT 转换保存在同一分区中,并使用可复制的目标图像来评估可见的复制和看不见的泛化. 与候选输入转换相比,对犬目误差和最小误差进行了比较,使测试对转换设置的灵敏度。 • 我们通过零镜头文本驱动配置、监督变体和参考指导配置,对先前研究的16种方法进行评估。 我们比较目标忠诚度 并评估它与语义一致的联系

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-Guided Image Editing. CLIPtone [ 17 ] adapts a LUT-based photo enhancer using CLIP [ 26 ] text directions, and CLIPtone-GO [ 24 ] refines the optimization to reduce artifacts. LCIT [ 23 ] fits a color transformation matrix. In contrast, InstantRetouch [ 35 ] predicts photometric transformations in bilateral space. CLIPstyler [ 16 ] , SpectralCLIP [ 37 ] , FastCLIPstyler [ 31 ] , and ZeCon [ 39 ] address text-guided style transfer. InstructPix2Pix [ 1 ] , SuperEdit [ 18 ] , StyleBooth [ 13 ] , SPL [ 10 ] , and Qwen-Image-Edit [ 34 ] support broader appearance edits. T2ONet [ 30 ] plans sequences of global adjustments. Retouching agents such as IEA [ 45 ] , MonetGPT [ 8 ] , and VeraRetouch [ 12 ] infer editing parameters. LUTBench compares representative methods across these categories under a shared protocol for text-driven photographic look transfer.

CLIPstyleer [16], SpectralCLIP [37], FastCLIPstyleer [31],和ZeCon [39] 地址为文本制导的样式传输. 指令Pix2Pix [1],SuperEdit [18],StyleBooth [13],SPL [10],以及Quen-Image-Edit [34] 支持更广泛的外观编辑. T2ONet [30] 全球调整计划序列. IEA[45],MonetGPT[8],VeraRetouch[12]等调试代理商推断编辑参数. LUT Bench在文本驱动的图片外观传输共享协议下比较了这些类别中的代表性方法.

blocks.en: LUT-Based and Reference-Guided Color Grading. Image-adaptive LUTs [ 41 ] and adaptive sampling intervals [ 38 ] support efficient photo enhancement. NILUT [ 5 ] represents transformations implicitly, and PG-IA-NILUT [ 15 ] exposes interpretable filter controls. Reference-guided methods match color statistics [ 27 ] or predict spatially adaptive LUTs [ 11 ] . AceTone [ 22 ] and StatLUT [ 32 ] extend LUT prediction to text conditioning. LUTBench fixes both the LUT and its canonical input conversion, so each canonical target image is independent of the evaluated method.
blocks.zh: 基于LUT和参考指引的颜色梯度. 图像适应LUT[41]和适应性采样间隔[38]支持高效的照片增强. NILUT [5] 表示暗中变换,PG-IA-NILUT [15] 暴露出可解释的过滤控制. 参考指导方法匹配颜色统计 [27] 或预测空间适应的LUT [11]. AceTone [22] 和StatLUT [32] 将LUT预测扩展为文本调制. LUT Bench既修饰LUT,又修饰其舟形输入转换,因此每个舟形目标图像独立于被评价的方法.

blocks.en: Color Grading and Retouching Benchmarks. FiveK [ 2 ] and PPR10K [ 19 ] provide expert-retouched targets. MA5k-Req [ 30 ] and iRetouch [ 35 ] pair individual photo edits with language requests. In contrast, PST50 [ 11 ] and the Retouch Transfer Dataset [ 9 ] use image references to specify the look. AceTone-Bench [ 22 ] provides LUT-rendered targets for both instruction- and reference-guided grading. However, its instruction subset uses descriptions generated for individual image-LUT pairs, which limits what aggregate scores reveal about fidelity to the same described look across photographs. LUTBench pairs each look with one description derived from measured tone and color changes and reuses that description across a common set of photographs with corresponding targets. Keeping similar looks in the same partition lets LUTBench assess seen-look reproduction and unseen-look generalization separately.
blocks.zh: 彩色分级和调整基准. FiveK [2]和PPR10K [19]提供专家调整的目标. MA5k-Req [30] 和 iRetouch [35] 组合个人照片编辑与语言请求. 相比之下,PST50 [11] 和 Retouch 传输数据集 [9] 使用图像引用来指定外观. AceTone-Bench [22] 提供LUT授予的指令和参考指导分级目标. 然而,其指令子集使用为单个图像-LUT对生成的描述,这限制了关于忠贞性的汇总分数所揭示的内容与描述的照片之间的相同外观. LUT Bench 配对,每个外观都有一个描述来自测量的语调和颜色变化以及重复使用,描述跨越一组具有相应目标的常见照片. 让LUT Bench分别评估外观复制和外观概括。

blocks.en: 3.2 Measurement-Based Look Descriptions
blocks.zh: 3.2 基于计量的外观描述

blocks.en: LUTBench look descriptions express four types of adjustment: tone, chroma, color cast (color introduced into initially neutral grays), and hue. We measure each LUT under its canonical input-conversion settings using the same predefined sRGB samples: 17 neutral grays and 480 chromatic colors. These measurements define 24 numerical attributes of the LUT’s tone and color effects. They quantify black and white points (the output lightness of black and white samples), contrast, color casts in neutral shadows, midtones, and highlights, and chroma and hue changes within six hue sectors. Tone attributes for shadows, midtones, and highlights measure output-minus-input lightness. Predefined templates use these measurements and numerical thresholds to generate candidate clauses, each a short statement specifying an adjustment’s region, direction, and degree. Examples include “neutral shadows rendered with a subtle blue cast” and “restrained chroma in blue hues.”

blocks.en: Before a LUT is applied, the input conversion specifies the encoding curve, RGB primaries, and exposure offset. These settings determine the RGB values supplied to the LUT, so changing them can alter the target image rendered from the same photograph. LUTBench fixes a canonical input conversion for each look using format metadata or input-conversion calibration against matched sRGB exports.

blocks.en: Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM) [ 33 ] , and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) [ 43 ] measure pixel, structural, and perceptual fidelity to canonical target images. Section A5 defines neutral-pixel error, chromatic-pixel error, and hue-balanced color error for locating color deviations. Signed lightness and chroma biases indicate whether outputs are lighter or darker, or more or less chromatic, than canonical targets. CLIP directional similarity is the cosine similarity between input-to-output image changes and the text direction from the source prompt “Normal photo.” to the look description in CLIP embedding space. blocks.en: 4.3 Paired Comparisons and Interpretation
blocks.zh: 4.3 比较和解释

blocks.en: The unedited input serves as a baseline for assessing whether editing improves target fidelity. For each look, we compute the evaluated method’s error minus the error of the unedited input or another method configuration. For canonical and minimum errors separately, we estimate a 95% percentile bootstrap confidence interval for the mean paired difference by resampling looks. An improvement is supported only when both intervals lie below zero. A deficit requires both intervals to lie above zero. Otherwise, the comparison is inconclusive. Agreement between comparisons using canonical and minimum errors shows that conclusions persist when predefined input-encoding alternatives are allowed. We test sensitivity by resampling whole look groups and evaluating look subsets selected by evidence for LUT input encoding or conversion sensitivity, as detailed in Sec. A5 .

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 实验和讨论

blocks.en: Experimental Settings. We evaluate 16 methods from prior research in 22 configurations: 14 zero-shot text-driven, one reference-guided, and seven supervised on LUTBench. Zero-shot denotes no training on LUTBench input-target pairs and allows per-image optimization. The zero-shot text-driven configurations span CLIP-guided tone, text style transfer, instruction editors, and retouching agents. Each text-driven method receives the look description formatted as a complete instruction or a style phrase, according to its input interface. AceTone receives a reference pair instead of the description: a training photograph and its canonical target image for the requested look. The supervised variants learn from LUTBench input-target pairs. Appendix B details the method and test settings.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 我们从先前的22种配置研究中评估了16种方法:14种零镜头文本驱动,1种参考制导,7种在LUT Bench上监督. 零镜头表示在LUT Bench输入目标对上没有训练,并允许每个图像优化. 零镜头文本驱动配置跨越了CLIP制导的基调,文本样式传输,指令编辑器,以及重修代理. 每种文本驱动方法都根据其输入界面收到格式化为完整指令或风格短语的外观描述. AceTone收到一对参考对而不是描述:训练照片及其用于要求的外观的犬形目标图像. 被监管的变体从LUT Bench输入目标对学习. 附 录 B详细介绍了方法和测试设置.

blocks.en: Zero-Shot and Reference-Guided Transfer. Among zero-shot text-driven methods, VeraRetouch has the lowest canonical error in CV, as shown in Tab. 1 . Detailed uncertainty estimates are in Sec. C1 . The unedited input itself has SSIM 0.873 and a canonical error of 8.65 Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} , showing that high structural similarity can coexist with tone and color errors. Reference-guided AceTone improves on the unedited input in CV. Its training reference pair directly specifies input-to-target color changes.

blocks.en: Supervised Transfer Across Both Tracks. Paired target supervision reduces canonical error relative to the corresponding zero-shot configurations. For example, InstructPix2Pix improves from 22.20 to 6.51 Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} in CV. For VeraRetouch, supervision improves fidelity while keeping the released model’s retouching plans fixed and training only the components that turn those plans into image adjustments. This shows that fidelity can improve at the image-adjustment stage without changing the textual plan. The gains vary across architectures. Six of seven supervised variants outperform the unedited input in CV, Test and the Seen track, supporting both reproduction of learned looks and transfer to unseen transformations. Section C2 presents results for the Seen track and discusses the performance gap with Test.

Some outputs also alter local textures. For example, StyleBooth renders coastal cloud and wave detail as broad, flat color regions. Repeating a color bias across photographs does not reproduce the requested transformation. Additional examples appear in Sec. E2 .

blocks.en: Semantic Alignment and Target Fidelity. Most zero-shot text-driven configurations have higher CLIP directional similarity than the canonical target images in Tab. 1 . However, their outputs deviate from the target colors. Across 21 configurations excluding AceTone, higher CLIP directional similarity accompanies larger canonical error in Fig. 7 (A) ( r = 0.78 r=0.78 ). After subtracting each metric’s category mean, the relationship is weakly negative in Fig. 7 (B) ( r = − 0.23 r=-0.23 ). The change after category centering indicates that differences between method categories contribute to the overall association. Cosine similarity is unchanged by positively rescaling an embedding difference vector. Thus, directional alignment does not directly constrain the magnitude of color changes. blocks.en: Look Specification and Conversion Sensitivity. Look descriptions summarize tone and color adjustments. The LUT and canonical input conversion specify the transformation used to render target images. Identical clause sets can describe different transformations because they summarize adjustment ranges, as detailed in Sec. A3 . LUTBench fixes the canonical input conversion for each look and tests sensitivity to predefined alternatives. Canonical and minimum errors support the same paired-comparison conclusions in CV. Across the input-conversion subsets in Sec. C1 , all six supervised configurations with supported CV improvements outperform the unedited input.

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Works. LUTBench covers global color transformations defined by 3D LUTs, not spatially local edits. Descriptions use a controlled clause vocabulary, which makes each clause verifiable but does not cover free-form requests. In future work, we will reformulate these descriptions as free-form requests that more closely resemble real user prompts and evaluate methods under this setting. We will also extend the evaluation to iterative editing, where users provide feedback on previous outputs to guide subsequent adjustments.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工程。 LUT Bench覆盖由3D LUT定义的全局色变,而非空间局部编辑. 描述使用受控条款词汇,这使得每个条款可以核查,但不包括自由形式请求. 在今后的工作中,我们将将这些描述重新拟订为自由形式,要求更接近真正的用户提示和评价这种环境下的方法。 我们还将把评价扩大到迭代编辑,用户提供以往产出的反馈,指导随后的调整。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce LUTBench, a benchmark that connects text descriptions, explicit color transformations and reproducible target images for photographic look transfer. From 91 collected 3D LUTs with canonical input conversions, we render 455,000 input-target pairs across 5,000 photographs. Measurement-based descriptions express each look’s tone and color changes in shared terms across photographs. This construction enables direct comparison of how faithfully different methods reproduce the same transformation as image content and initial colors change. The Seen track and Unseen track distinguish reproduction of learned looks from generalization to held-out transformations, with paired comparisons testing sensitivity to input conversion. The evaluation distinguishes semantic alignment from target fidelity. By coupling measurable descriptions with paired targets, LUTBench supports both controlled evaluation and supervised learning. It provides a basis for studying how models translate language into precise color adjustments and for evaluating consistent, controllable look transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LUT Bench,这个基准将文本描述,清晰的色彩转换和可复制的目标图像连接起来,用于图片外观传输. 我们从91个收集到的3D LUT中,通过犬形输入转换,将45.5万对输入目标成对,横跨5000张照片. 基于测量的描述表达每种外观的语调和不同照片的共用术语的颜色变化. 这种构造可以直接比较不同方法如何像图像内容和初始颜色变化一样,忠实地复制同样的变换. Seenn音轨和Unseen音轨区分了学习到的外观的复制,从泛化到牵引变换,配对比较测试对输入转换的敏感性. 评价将语义一致与目标忠诚区分开来. LUT Bench通过将可计量描述与配对目标结合,支持受控评价和监督学习。 它为研究模型如何将语言转化为精确的色彩调整以及评价一致的,可控制的外观转移提供了基础.

blocks.en: We compare five description variants using LUT predictors conditioned on binary indicators of clause presence, bag-of-words features, or frozen CLIP text embeddings. The selected rule gives the lowest mean CIEDE2000 error across these three models on 40 held-out CV looks and validation photographs. Test-look descriptions use the same fixed-color measurements and training-photograph checks. Attribute normalization and inverse-frequency clause weights are computed across the 91-look library and shared by all methods. No method is trained on LUTBench test-look image pairs.

blocks.en: On validation photographs, the 541 clause occurrences checked using image measurements achieve 93.1% support for their full numerical conditions and 98.8% agreement in direction alone. Both rates use the inverse-frequency weights in Sec. A6 to average measurable clauses within each photograph, then over photographs and equally over all 91 looks, including the 10 test looks.

The CLIPtone models trained independently for the five CV held-out subsets follow the same training procedure as the corresponding canonical-error comparison. The canonical target images provide reference values of 94% clause satisfaction and 0.036 CLIP directional similarity.
blocks.zh: CLIP方向相似性和条款满足度使用所有40张CV外观和所有500张验证照片. 每种方法都遵循目标可靠性评价的推论设置. CLIPtone模型为5个CV被扣子集独立培训,遵循与相应的Cononical-error比较相同的培训程序. 犬形目标图像提供了94%条款满意度和0.036 CLIP方向相似度的参考值.

blocks.en: Association with Target Fidelity. For Fig. 7 in the main paper, CLIP directional similarity and canonical error are computed from the same output images. Each 8-bit RGB output is compared with its 16-bit canonical target. The reference-guided category contains only AceTone. Therefore, both panels compare the same 21 configurations from the other five method categories in Tab. 1 in the main paper.
blocks.zh: 与目标菲德尔联系. 为法智. 7在主纸中,CLIP方向相似性和犬形误差是从相同的输出图像计算出来的. 每个8位的RGB输出都与其16位的犬形目标进行比较. 参考指导类只包含AceTone. 因此,这两个面板将相同的21个配置与Tab的其他五个方法类别进行比较. 主报一.

blocks.en: Panel A uses the original configuration means and an ordinary least-squares fit with an intercept. Panel B subtracts each category’s configuration mean from both coordinates, without standard-deviation normalization. Its dashed line is a pooled least-squares fit through the origin, equivalent to fitting a common slope with category-specific intercepts.
blocks.zh: 小组讨论会 A使用原始配置手段和适合拦截的普通最小方块. 小组讨论会 B 从两个坐标中减去每个类别的配置平均值,而不进行标准调整正常化。 它的破损线是经过原产地的集合最小方块,相当于安装一个具有特定类别拦截的通用坡度.

blocks.en: Appendix B Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 附录B 设置

blocks.en: B1 Common Implementation Settings
blocks.zh: B1 通用执行设置

blocks.en: Instruction interfaces receive the complete look description d l d_{l} . Style-phrase interfaces remove “Apply a photographic look with” and the final period. In the prompt templates below, “ { d } ” denotes this remaining style phrase. The default random seed is 2026 ⋅ 10 6 + 1000 ​ l + i 2026\cdot 10^{6}+1000l+i , where l l is the look index and i i is the photograph position in the evaluation set. The default inference platform is Windows with a 32 GB RTX 5090. Diffusion editors process batches of eight photographs with matching dimensions. Learning-rate selection uses the first CV held-out subset, and the selected rate is fixed for the remaining models.
blocks.zh: 指令界面收到完整的外观描述 dl d_{l}. 样式句式界面删除“使用照片查看”和最后一段。 在下面的快速模板中,“{ d} ” 表示这个剩余样式短语。 默认随机种子为2026  10 6 + 1000l + i 2026\cdot 10^{6}+10000l+i,其中ll为外观指数,i为评价集中的照片位置. 默认推断平台为Windows,带有32GB RTX 5090. 扩散编辑器处理8张相片的批次,具有匹配尺寸. 学习率选择使用第一个CV hold-out子集,其余模型的选定率是固定的.

blocks.en: The supervised InstructPix2Pix, SuperEdit and StyleBooth variants share a diffusion training recipe. The U-Net is trained with the variational autoencoder and text encoder frozen. Each uses 600 training photographs per look. Both images in each training pair are quantized to 8-bit RGB and directly resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , followed by paired horizontal flips. AdamW runs for 15,000 steps at batch size 16 and learning rate 5 ⋅ 10 − 5 5\cdot 10^{-5} . Training uses bf16 autocast, conditioning dropout 0.05, and mean squared error between predicted and sampled noise. Each variant uses its own instruction template, diffusion scheduler and released inference settings.

Parameter counts cover one instantiated editing system, including frozen encoders and counting shared weights once. Counts use checkpoint tensor shapes and model definitions, excluding fixed renderers, fitted per-image color coefficients and evaluation networks.
blocks.zh: 参数计数包括一个即时编辑系统,包括冷冻编码器和一次计算共享权重. 计数使用检查站的变压器形状和模型定义,不包括固定的渲染器,安装了每个图像的颜色系数和评价网络.

blocks.en: B2 Evaluated Methods
blocks.zh: B2 评价的方法

blocks.en:
CLIPtone (CVPR, 2024) [ 17 ] .
The 155.6M-parameter configuration combines an AiLUT enhancer with an RN50 text adapter. It uses the direction from “Normal photo.” to the complete description without its final period followed by “photo.” , at intensity 1 and the saved image resolution. LUT lookup follows the released kernel’s axis convention. On LUTBench, the main supervised variant trains the enhancer and text adapter from scratch using the initialization routines in the released code, with one identity basis LUT and the remaining basis LUTs initialized to 0. Each step uses 64 photographs, four looks and 512 pixels per photograph. Training runs for 8,000 steps with L1 loss, smoothness weight 10 − 3 10^{-3} and monotonicity weight 10 − 2 10^{-2} . AdamW uses 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4} , selected by canonical error from { 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 , 3 ⋅ 10 − 3 } \{3\cdot 10^{-4},10^{-3},3\cdot 10^{-3}\} . The supervised adapter and full fine-tuning variants use the same losses at 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4} and 3 ⋅ 10 − 3 3\cdot 10^{-3} . These supervised variants use 200 warm-up steps followed by cosine learning-rate decay. The CLIP-objective adapter variant freezes the enhancer and uses 32 crops per step, Adam at 10 − 3 10^{-3} , content and directional weights 1, weight regularization 10 − 4 10^{-4} and interval regularization 0.5 for 8,000 steps. Original training uses 4,500 FiveK inputs and the Color Names Dataset. Testing uses 500 FiveK photographs and 50 tone descriptions. A reference-based comparison uses 9 Lightroom filters.
blocks.zh:
CLIPTone (CVPR, 2024) [17].
155.6M参数配置结合了AiLUT增强器和RN50文本适配器. 它使用从“普通照片”到完整描述的方向,然后是“照片”。 在强度1和保存的图像分辨率下。 LUT 追随释放的内核轴公约进行搜索 。 在LUT Bench上,主受监督的变体利用发布代码中的初始化常规,从头开始训练增强器和文本适配器,一个身份基LUT,剩余基LUT初始化为0. 每一步使用64张照片,4张外观和512像素. 训练为8000步,L1减速,光滑重量10−3 10−3}单调重量10−2 10−2}. AdamW使用 3 → 10 → 4 → 3\cdot 10 → 4},由 {3 → 10 → 4 → 10 → 3 → 3 → 3 → 10 → 3}}} 3\cdot 10\ → 3} 选取。 受监督的适配器和全微调变体使用相同的损失,分别是3 × 10 − 4 3\cdot 10× 4}和3 × 10 − 3\cdot 10× 3}。 这些受监督的变体使用200个热身步骤,然后是余弦学习率衰减. CLIP-客观适配器变体将增强器冻结,每步使用32个作物,亚当为10−3 10^{-3},内容和方向重量为1,重量规范为10−4 10^{-4}间隔规范为8000步0.5. 原始训练使用4500个5K输入和彩色名称数据集. 测试使用500张5K照片和50个音调描述. 基于参考的比较使用9个灯房滤波器.

blocks.en:
LCIT (CIC, 2025) [ 23 ] .
The 151.3M-parameter configuration fits a white-preserving 3 × 3 3\times 3 color matrix in linear light using OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 with LAION-2B weights. LCIT is implemented from the paper . The prompt is “A { d } photo” . Loss computation uses a 224-pixel center crop, matrix offsets are bounded by 0.25, and Adam runs for 1,000 iterations per photograph at 2 ⋅ 10 − 3 2\cdot 10^{-3} . Original tests use 24 public Kodak Lossless True Color images with color, cultural and emotion prompts.
blocks.zh:
LCIT (CIC, 2025) [23] (中文(简体) ).
151.3M参数配置适合线性光线中的白色保留3×3 3\时的3色矩阵,使用OpenCLIP VIT-B/32配有LAION-2B重量. LCIT由该文件实施。 提示是“A { d } 照片”。 损失计算使用224像素中心作物,矩阵抵消以0.25为界,亚当每张照片运行1000次重复,时间为2~10~3 2\cdot 10~3}。 原始测试使用24张公开的Kodak Lossless True Color图像,带有色彩,文化和情感的提示.

blocks.en:
CLIPstyler (CVPR, 2022) [ 16 ] .
The 158.3M-parameter configuration uses the fast decoder initialized from AdaIN, with a random seed set per look. One decoder is fitted per look for 200 iterations on DIV2K crops, using the style phrase in 79 ImageNet templates and source prompt “a Photo” . Inference preserves the full frame at long side 512, with contrast 1.5 and min-max stretching. In contrast, the original per-image variant optimizes on input crops. Original demonstrations include content examples and CelebA-HQ facial style transfer.
blocks.zh:
CLIP样式器(CVPR, 2022) [16].
158.3M参数配置使用从AdaIN初始化的快速解码器,每个外观都有一个随机的种子集. 使用79个ImageNet模板中的样式短语, 推论保留了长边512的全帧,对比1.5和分钟-马克斯拉伸. 相比之下,最初的逐象变体优化了投入作物. 最初的演示包括内容实例和CelebA-HQ面部风格的转移.

blocks.en:
FastCLIPstyler (WACV, 2024) [ 31 ] .
The 153.5M-parameter configuration encodes the style phrase with CLIP ViT-B/32 and applies the released stylization network deterministically at the saved image size. The LUTBench supervised variant freezes CLIP and trains the text embedder and stylization network with L1 loss on 200 photographs per look, random 208 2 208^{2} crops and flips. AdamW runs for 8,000 steps at batch size 16 and rate 3 ⋅ 10 − 3 3\cdot 10^{-3} , selected by canonical error from { 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 , 3 ⋅ 10 − 3 } \{3\cdot 10^{-4},10^{-3},3\cdot 10^{-3}\} . Training uses 200 warm-up steps followed by cosine learning-rate decay. Original training uses 4,300 keyword-composed prompts and 1,500 ChatGPT-generated prompts, with a stylizer pretrained on Painter by Numbers and DTD. Testing uses 80 prompts, partly drawn from DTD and ArtEmis, and AdaAttn-rendered semi-reference targets.
blocks.zh:
FastCLIPstyleer (WACV, 2024) [31] (英语).
153.5M-参数配置用CLIP ViT-B/32编码了样式短语,并在保存的图像大小上对释放的stylization网络进行确定性应用. LUT Bench监督的变体冻结了CLIP,并训练了文本嵌入器和stylization网络,每张外观有200张照片L1丢失,随机208 2 208^{2}作物和翻转. 亚当 W在批量大小16和速率3 ×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××年××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× 训练使用200个热身步骤,然后是余弦学习率衰减。 原始训练使用4,300个关键词组合的提示和1,500个ChatGPT生成的提示,由数字和DTD在Painter上预加了定型器. 测试使用80个提示符,部分来自DTD和ArtEmis,以及AdaAttn-resisted半引用目标.

blocks.en:
SpectralCLIP (WACV, 2024) [ 37 ] .
The 171.9M-parameter configuration introduces spectral filtering into CLIPstyler’s per-image optimization. It uses the same phrase templates, long side 512, 200 optimization steps with 64 crops, spectral band c2, contrast 1.5 and min-max stretching. Up to four independent image-specific networks are optimized in parallel. The original evaluation comprises 100 image-style groups using COCO validation images.
blocks.zh:
SpectralCLIP(WACV, 2024) [37].
171.9M参数的配置将光谱过滤引入CLIPstyleer的每个图像优化. 它使用相同的短语模板,长边512,200优化步骤,有64种作物,光谱带c2,对比1.5和分马克斯拉伸. 最多四个独立图像特有网络平行优化. 最初的评价包括100个使用COCO验证图像的图像风格组.

blocks.en:
ZeCon (ICCV, 2023) [ 39 ] .
The 722.5M-parameter configuration uses the public unconditional ADM backbone at 256 2 256^{2} resolution. It receives the style phrase as the target prompt and “Photo” as the source prompt. Inference uses DDIM forward and DDPM reverse sampling, with a 50-timestep schedule, 25 skipped timesteps and one output sample per input. The input is resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , and the output is restored to the saved input dimensions. Original tests use FFHQ, CelebA-HQ, ImageNet, LSUN-Church and CycleGAN datasets, plus WikiArt for unseen-domain transfer.
blocks.zh:
ZeCon (ICCV, 2023) [39] (英语).
722.5M参数配置使用公共无条件的ADM主干线,分辨率为256 2 256^{2}. 它接收样式短语作为目标提示,而“图片”作为源提示。 推论采用DDIM向前和DDPM反向取样,每输入一个50时步表,25个跳过时步和1个输出样本. 输入大小调整为256×256256\times 256,输出恢复到保存的输入维度. 原始测试使用FFHQ,CelebA-HQ,ImageNet,LSUN-Church和CycleGAN数据集,加上WikiArt用于无形域传输.

blocks.en:
SPL (WACV, 2026) [ 10 ] .
The 1.066B-parameter configuration performs training-free optimization with LCM-Dreamshaper-v7. It uses the text direction from “a photo” to “a photo with { d } ” , 15 sampling steps, source and target guidance scales of 1 and 2, respectively, and 100 optimization iterations. Inputs are resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 , with outputs restored to the saved dimensions. Original tests use curated PIE-Bench and AnyEdit subsets, with FiveK for tone adjustment and DPST for photographic style transfer.
blocks.zh:
SPL (WACV, 2026) [10].
1.066B参数配置采用LCM-Dreamshaper-v7进行无培训优化. 它使用“照片”到“{d}照片”的文字方向、15个取样步骤、1和2的源和目标制导尺度以及100个优化迭代。 投入被调整为512×512 512\时,输出恢复到保存的维度. 原始测试使用经曲制的PIE-Bench和AnyEdit子集,音调调整用FiveK,照片风格传输用DPST.

blocks.en:
InstructPix2Pix (CVPR, 2023) [ 1 ] .
The 1.066B-parameter editor receives the full description and processes photographs at long side 512. Released inference uses 100 steps, text guidance 7.5 and image guidance 1.5. The LUTBench supervised variant updates the U-Net using the shared diffusion recipe in Sec. B1 . Original training constructs about 450,000 edits from LAION-Aesthetics V2 6.5+ captions, GPT-3 instructions and Prompt-to-Prompt pairs. Evaluation compares CLIP similarities across 2,000 edits and presents real-photo and artwork examples.
blocks.zh:
指导Pix2Pix(CVPR,2023)[1].
1.066B参数编辑器在512号长侧接收完整描述和处理照片。 释放的推论使用100步,文字指导7.5和图像指导1.5. LUT Bench 监督变体使用 Sec. B1 中共享的传播配方更新了U-Net. 原始训练从LAION-Alectics V2 6.5+字幕,GPT-3指令和即时对Prompt对中构建了约45万个编辑. 评价比较了2 000个编辑版的CLIP相似性,并介绍了真实图片和艺术品实例。

blocks.en:
SuperEdit (ICCV, 2025) [ 18 ] .
The 1.066B-parameter SD1.5 configuration uses the full description, long side 512, 50 Euler ancestral steps, text guidance 10, image guidance 1.5 and fp16 inference. The LUTBench supervised variant trains the U-Net with the shared diffusion recipe in Sec. B1 , using the same inference settings. The original 40,000 training pairs combine InstructPix2Pix (10,177), MagicBrush (8,807) and Seed-Data-Edit (21,016). Original tests use the public MultiReward Real-Edit and MagicBrush single-turn test sets.
blocks.zh:
SuperEdit(ICCV,2025) [18] (英语).
1.066B参数的SD1.5配置采用了完整的描述,长侧512,50欧勒祖阶,文本指导10,图像指导1.5和fp16推论. LUT Bench监督的变体在Sec.B1中使用相同的推论设置,用共享的传播食谱对U-Net进行训练. 最初的4万对训练对结合了InstructPix2Pix(10,177),MagicBrush(8,807)和Seed-Data-Edit(21,016). 原始测试使用公共的MultiReward Real-Edit和MagicBrush单回合测试集.

blocks.en:
StyleBooth (ICCV Workshops, 2025) [ 13 ] .
The 1.066B-parameter text checkpoint uses SCEPTER with prompt “Let this image be in the style of { d } ” . Full-frame inference at long side 1024 uses 50 DDIM steps, text guidance 7.5, image guidance 1.5, rescale 0.5 and fp16. PyTorch fused attention preserves the released scale. The supervised variant uses the shared diffusion recipe in Sec. B1 with StyleBooth’s template and scheduler. Original training uses the StyleBooth Dataset, generated with SDXL and Fooocus templates. Original tests use 226 public style edits from Emu Edit .
blocks.zh:
StyleBooth (ICCV讲习班,2025) [13].
1.066B参数的文本检查点使用SCEPTER,并带有“让这个图像采用{d}的样式”。 长侧1024的全帧推论采用50个DDIM步骤,文本引导7.5,图像引导1.5,重缩0.5和fp16. PyTorch 熔化的注意力保留了释放的尺度. 受监督的变体使用Sec.B1中的共享传播配方,配有StyleBooth的模板和排程器. 原始训练使用StyleBooth数据集,用SDXL和Foocus模板生成. 原始测试使用226 公共风格编辑 来自 Emu Edit 。

blocks.en:
Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (Model Release, 2025) [ 34 ] .
The 28.85B-parameter configuration uses the full description, native pipeline resolution, 40 steps, true CFG 4.0 and a blank negative prompt. Inference uses bf16 without weight quantization on H100 80 GB GPUs, with one model instance per GPU. The cited series report describes collected image-text data and synthetic edits, and evaluates on the public GEdit-Bench and ImgEdit benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
Quen-Image-Edit-2511(2025年模式发布) [34].
28.85B参数配置采用完整描述,本土管道分辨率,40步,真CFG4.0和空白负速率. 推论在H100 80 GB GPU上使用bf16不重量化,每个GPU有一个模型实例. 引用的系列报告描述了收集的图像文本数据和合成编辑,并在公共Gedit-Bench和ImgEdit基准上进行了评价.

blocks.en:
IEA (CVPR Findings, 2026) [ 45 ] .
The 8.292B-parameter configuration uses a Qwen2.5-VL-7B policy to select among 16 global editing tools. IEA receives the full description and the input photograph at its saved resolution. It uses greedy decoding, up to 1,024 tokens and three attempts. Inference uses the released messages and decoding settings through Transformers. Original training distills tool trajectories from GIER and synthesizes editing and refinement examples from GIER and FiveK. Original tests use these public datasets and a user study of 50 GIER examples.
blocks.zh:
IEA(CVPR调查结果,2026) [45].
8.292B参数配置采用Quen2.5-VL-7B政策,从16个全局编辑工具中选择. 国际能源机构收到完整描述和保存分辨率的输入照片。 它使用贪婪的解码,多达1,024个符和三次尝试. 推论使用发布的信息,并通过变形器解码设置. 原始训练从GIER中提取工具轨迹,并综合了GIER和FiveK的编辑和完善实例. 原始测试使用这些公共数据集和用户对50个GIER实例的研究.

blocks.en:
MonetGPT (TOG, 2025) [ 8 ] .
The 8.291B-parameter Qwen2-VL-7B configuration appends the full description to each of three editing stages, using style “balanced” , temperature 0.3, top- p p 0.7 and top- k k 50. It uses the released messages and decoding settings through Transformers, with the random seed set per batch of 25 photographs and NumPy and GIMP 2.10 rendering at the saved resolution. Original training constructs visual puzzles from PPR10K Expert A retouches. Cross-dataset testing uses 400 FiveK photographs, and user studies include FiveK and Reddit images.
blocks.zh:
MonetGPT(TOG,2025) [8] (英语).
8.291B参数 Qune2-VL-7B配置将完整描述附加到三个编辑阶段的每个阶段,使用样式"均衡",温度0.3,顶端-p p 0.7和顶端-k k 50. 它通过变形器使用已发布的消息和解码设置,每批25张照片的随机种子集和保存分辨率的NumPy和GIMP 2.10渲染. 原始训练从 PPR10K 专家 A 中构建视觉谜题. 跨数据集测试使用400张五K照片,用户研究包括五K和Reddit图像.

blocks.en:
VeraRetouch (SIGGRAPH, 2026) [ 12 ] .
The 634.0M-parameter configuration combines FastVLM-0.5B with a renderer. Its retouch head maps VLM hidden states to parameters applied by the renderer. The full description enters the style-mode template, with VLM short side 512, temperature 0.2, top- p p 0.8 and one attempt. Rendering uses the saved image resolution. The LUTBench variant freezes the VLM and trains the retouch head and renderer with L1 loss on 16,384 sampled pixels per output. For each training look, the released model generates a retouching plan for each of 16 training photographs, and the corresponding VLM hidden states provide the retouch head inputs. AdamW uses batch size 16, 4,000 steps and rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , selected by validation L1 loss from { 3 ⋅ 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 , 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 } \{3\cdot 10^{-5},10^{-4},3\cdot 10^{-4}\} . Training uses 200 warm-up steps followed by cosine learning-rate decay. At evaluation, the frozen VLM receives the current photograph, its look description, and the zero-shot retouching plan previously generated for that photograph and look. The plan is supplied as fixed text, and the resulting hidden states feed the trained retouch head. Original training uses AetherRetouch-1M+, combining FiveK and PPR10K expert retouches with Unsplash-Full images and 5,030 Lightroom presets. Tests cover Aether-Bench, FiveK-Bench and supplementary PPR10K-Bench results.
blocks.zh:
Vera Retouch (SIGGRAPH, 2026) [12] (英语).
634.0M参数配置将FastVLM-0.5B与渲染器结合. 它将头图 VLM 隐藏状态重整为渲染器应用的参数. 完整描述进入样式-模版模板,VLM短侧512,温度0.2,顶端-p 0.8和一次尝试. 渲染使用保存的图像分辨率 。 LUT Bench变体冻结了VLM,并在每输出16,384个样本的像素上对回触头和渲染器进行L1损失的训练. 对于每次训练外观,发行的模型都会为16张训练照片中的每一张生成一个重修计划,相应的VLM隐藏状态提供重修头部输入. blocks.en:
AceTone (CVPR, 2026) [ 22 ] .
The evaluated 3.760B-parameter PST preview uses a reference pair instead of a text description: one training photograph and its canonical target image under the requested look. For each look, the reference photograph is drawn uniformly from the training photographs using a fixed seed specific to that look. The same reference pair is used for all evaluated input photographs under that look. Greedy decoding predicts 64 LUT tokens. The decoded LUT is applied at the saved image resolution using the released channel and lattice conventions. Original training uses MS-COCO pretraining and FiveK/PPR10K fine-tuning, including about 800,000 instruction-guided grading examples. Testing uses AceTone-Bench Instruct (128 examples), Transfer (1,024) and PST-50.
blocks.zh:
AceTone (CVPR, 2026) [22].
评价的3.760B参数 PST预览使用参考对而非文字描述:在请求的外观下使用一张训练照片及其犬形目标图像. 对于每种外观,参考照片均统一取自训练照片,其中使用一种特定外观的固定种子。 该表情下的所有评价输入照片都使用同样的参考对. 贪婪的解码预言64LUT符号. 解码的LUT在保存的图像解析度上应用了释放的通道和纹章常规. 原始培训采用MS-COCO预训和5K/PPR10K微调,包括约80万个教学指导分级例. 测试使用AceTone-Bench指令(128例),传输(1,024)和PST-50.

blocks.en:
PG-IA-NILUT (ACM MM, 2024) [ 15 ] .
The 0.449M-parameter FiveK model converts five sliders into one 33 3 33^{3} LUT, applied at the saved resolution with trilinear interpolation at the released implementation’s uniform grid vertices. For LUTBench, five slider values are fitted per training look using L1 loss, 256 photographs and 512 pixels per photograph at each step. Adam runs for 400 steps at 0.05 with cosine decay and slider bounds [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . Ridge regression predicts slider values from a binary vector indicating which description clauses are present. The vocabulary contains the K K distinct clauses in the current training-look descriptions, with one additional entry for clauses outside this vocabulary, giving K + 1 K+1 features. Each slider is standardized using its mean and standard deviation over the training looks, with the standard deviation bounded below by 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The regression uses an unpenalized intercept and selects among 13 penalties, { 10 − 3 , 10 − 2.5 , … , 10 3 } \{10^{-3},10^{-2.5},\ldots,10^{3}\} , by exact leave-one-out cross-validation over training looks. At inference, predictions are converted back to slider values and clipped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] before LUT generation. Original training uses 4,500 FiveK Expert C photographs and 8,875 PPR10K Expert A photographs, with 500 and 2,286 test photographs and expert-retouched targets.

blocks.en: B3 Method Selection and Availability
blocks.zh: B3 方法选择和提供

blocks.en: LUTBench evaluates methods that edit a whole photograph from a text description and run from public code and weights. Methods without a public implementation are reimplemented only when they require no training, which applies to LCIT. AceTone targets text-conditioned grading, and its released PST preview is evaluated with a reference pair, as described in Sec. B2 . Table S3 lists the releases used for the evaluated methods and groups the related methods that are not evaluated by the reason for exclusion.
blocks.zh: LUT Bench评价从文本描述中编辑整张照片和从公共代码和权重中运行的方法. 没有公开实施的方法只有在不需要培训的情况下才能重新实施,这适用于《远程教育法》。 AceTone目标为文本条件的分级,其发布的PST预览会像 Sec. B2 中描述的那样以参考对评价. 表S3列出了用于评估方法的释放情况,并列出了未按排除原因评估的相关方法。

blocks.en: As of November 2026, six related methods have no runnable public model. CLIPtone-GO [ 24 ] and PixTalk [ 4 ] have announced but unreleased implementations, and we found no public code or weights for RetouchIQ [ 36 ] and StatLUT [ 32 ] . InstantRetouch [ 35 ] provides inference code without a checkpoint, and GenColor [ 7 ] releases its texture-preservation network without the color-enhancement model. Each of these methods requires training, so the reimplementation criterion does not cover them. StatLUT also depends on an unreleased collection of 10,000 training LUTs.
blocks.zh: 截至2026年11月,6种相关方法没有可循环的公共模式. CLIPtone-GO [24] 和 PixTalk [4] 已宣布但未发布执行,我们发现没有为RetouchIQ [36] 和 StatLUT [32] 提供公共代码或权重. 即时Retoch [35] 提供没有检查点的推论代码,GenColor [7] 发布其纹理-保护网络,没有增色模型. 每种方法都需要培训,因此重新实施的标准并不涵盖这些方法。 StatLUT还依赖于1万个训练LUT的未发行集合.

blocks.en: JarvisArt [ 20 ] and JarvisEvo [ 21 ] render edits through Adobe Lightroom Classic, which is proprietary software outside the open-source pipeline shared by the evaluated methods. The PerTouch [ 3 ] agent requires a user-specified VLM service, which the release does not identify, and an access-restricted SAM3 checkpoint. T2ONet [ 30 ] encodes requests with an LSTM over a closed vocabulary learned from its MA5k-Req and GIER [ 29 ] training requests, so it cannot represent clause terms outside those requests.
blocks.zh: 贾维斯艺术[20]和贾维斯 Evo [21]通过Adobe Lightroom Classic进行编辑,这是被评价方法共享的开源管道以外的专有软件. PerTouch [3] 代理需要用户指定的VLM服务(发布时没有识别),以及限制访问的SAM3检查站. T2ONet [30] 将请求用LSTM编码在从它的MA5k-Req和GIER[29]培训请求中吸取的闭塞词汇上,因此不能代表这些请求以外的条款术语.

blocks.en: SA-LUT [ 11 ] , ICTone [ 6 ] , INRetouch [ 9 ] , Deep Preset [ 14 ] and Personalized Image Filter [ 44 ] define the look through reference images, which places them outside text-driven look transfer. EyeControl [ 25 ] targets visual-focus enhancement and conditions on a local instruction and a spatial focus target in addition to a global instruction. ColorCtrl [ 40 ] changes the color or material of an object named in the prompt. Both methods address local edits rather than a global photographic look.
blocks.zh: SA-LUT [11],ICTone [6],INRetoch [9],Deep Preset [14]和个性化图像过滤器 [44]通过参考图像定义外观,将其置于文本驱动外观传输之外. 眼控[25]除了全球指令外,还针对局部指令和空间重点目标进行视觉聚焦增强和条件提升. ColorCtrl [40] 改变在提示中命名的对象的颜色或材料. 这两种方法都涉及本地编辑,而不是全局图片外观.

blocks.en: Appendix D Human Evaluation of Look Descriptions
blocks.zh: 附录D 对外观描述的人类评价

blocks.en: Study Objective. Human evaluation assessed the visual accuracy of look descriptions against canonical input-target pairs. Table S7 summarizes the results.
blocks.zh: 学习目标。 人类评价对照犬科输入目标对外观描述的视觉准确性进行了评估。 表S7汇总了结果。

blocks.en: Materials and Sampling. We sampled three photographs for each of the 91 looks from the validation photographs. Photograph identifiers were sorted and permuted with NumPy PCG64 at seed 2027. The first 273 photographs were assigned in groups of three to sorted look identifiers, without reuse across looks. Descriptions, canonical input conversions, image pairs and analysis rules were fixed before rating.
blocks.zh: 材料与采样. 我们从鉴定照片中抽取了91张照片中的3张。 2027种子时与NumPy PCG64对照片标识进行了分类和穿透。 首批273张照片分为3组,用于排序外观识别器,不重复使用。 描述,犬形输入转换,图像对和分析规则在评分前是固定的.

blocks.en: Participants and Assignment. We assigned 35 distinct looks and 105 input-target pairs to each of 13 adults who could read English and did not construct the benchmark. The participants were primarily university students, and all had some experience in photography and photo editing. Five independent raters per look completed 455 assignments and 1,365 image-pair assessments. Participants provided informed consent.
blocks.zh: 参与者与任务。 我们给13个成年人每人分配了35个不同的外观和105个输入目标对,他们可以读英文,没有构建基准。 学员主要是大学生,在摄影和摄影编辑方面都有一定经验. 每张照片有5名独立评定员完成了455项任务和1 365次图像拍摄评估。 与会者提供了知情同意。

blocks.en: Presentation. As shown in Fig. S1 , each assignment presented a full look description with three full-frame Input/Target pairs, viewed one at a time with Input at left. Look and photograph order were randomized per participant. Clause order followed the look description. Images shared the sRGB display conversion, dimensions and synchronized zoom, without cropping. Participants used a desktop or laptop with night mode and automatic color adjustments disabled. Brief instructions explained tone, chroma, color cast, hue and the response options. Thresholds, support rates, LUT identities and method scores were hidden. Breaks were available every five looks.
blocks.zh: 介绍. 如图S1所示,每项任务都给出了完整的外观描述,并配有3个全帧输入/目标对,一次看一个,左看输入. 每位参与者都随机查看和拍照。 条款顺序沿用了外观描述。 图像共享 sRGB 显示转换,维度和同步缩放,不裁剪. 与会者使用一台台式计算机或膝上型计算机,夜间模式和自动色彩调整被禁用。 简要说明解释了语气、铬、彩色铸造、色调和反应选项。 阈值,支持率,LUT身份和方法分数被隐藏. 每5个外观都有休息时间。

blocks.en: Questions and Response Options. The screen asked “Does the change match the description?” and instructed participants to compare Input and Target and rate how accurately each clause describes the visible change. Each clause had five numbered buttons, with visible anchors “1 No match”, “3 Partial match” and “5 Full match”. The expandable “Rating guide” provided the following definitions: • 1: Does not match at all. The description does not match the visible change at all. • 2: Mostly does not match. Most of the description does not match the visible change. • 3: Partly matches. The description partly matches, with clear discrepancies. • 4: Mostly matches. The description mostly matches, with only a minor difference in degree. • 5: Fully matches. Region or color, direction and any stated degree match. Without a degree qualifier, matching region and direction suffices. Scores measure description accuracy. A stronger change receives a higher score only if it better matches the description. A separate “No relevant content” option let participants skip clauses whose referenced color or region was absent. This option received no score and required no additional explanation.
blocks.zh: 问答选择. 屏幕询问“修改是否与描述相符?” 并指示参与者比较“输入和目标”并评分每个条款如何准确描述可见的变化。 每个条款都有五个编号按钮,有可见锚“1无匹配”、“3部分匹配”和“5完全匹配”。 可扩展的“比例指南”提供了以下定义: 1:完全不符。 描述与可见的变化完全不符. • 2: 基本不匹配。 大多数描述与可见的变化不匹配. • 3:部分匹配。 描述部分吻合,有明显的差异. • 4:基本匹配。 描述大多吻合,程度差别不大. • 5:完全匹配。 区域或颜色、方向和任何表明的学位匹配。 没有学位限定词,匹配区域和方向就足够了。 分数测量描述精度. 更强烈的改变只有在更符合描述的情况下才会得到更高的分数. 单独的“无相关内容”选项允许参与者跳过未提及颜色或区域的条款。 这个选项没有得分,不需要附加解释.

blocks.en: Evaluation Measures. The primary measure is the mean description-match score on the 1–5 scale. Additional measures are the fractions of scores at least four and equal to five, which use numeric responses as denominators, and the content-skip rate, which uses all answered items. For cross-photograph consistency, a unit is one participant’s ratings of one clause on the three photographs of a look. A unit is eligible when all three responses are numeric and scores one when all three ratings are at least four. Each measure is computed within each look and then averaged equally across looks with a nonzero denominator. Ordinal Krippendorff’s α \alpha measures inter-rater agreement on the five-point scale, with each look-photograph-clause combination as an item and content skips treated as missing.
blocks.zh: 评价措施。 主要衡量标准为1–5级的平均值描述-比分. 附加度量法是分数至少4分,等于5分的分数,这些分数使用数字反应作为分母,而内容-skip率则使用所有应答项目. 对于交叉摄影的一致性,一个单位是参与者在三张照片上对一个条款的评级。 当所有三个回复都是数字化的,当所有三个评分都至少四个时,一个单位就有资格获得1分. 每种量度在每次外观中计算,然后用非零分母对外观进行平均。 Krippendorff 的 α\ alpha 度量衡在五点尺度上的校对协议,

blocks.en: Approximate 95% confidence intervals for all means and proportions in Tab. S7 use the percentile method over 2,000 crossed bootstrap replicates with seed 2027. Each replicate resamples looks and participants independently, weights each rating by the product of their resampling counts and keeps photographs and clauses attached to their looks. Replicates without an eligible denominator are omitted. The interval for α \alpha resamples complete look blocks 2,000 times with seed 2027, keeping all items, ratings and missing responses in each block with the rater panel fixed.
blocks.zh: 在Tab中,所有手段和比例的置信间隔约为95%。 S7使用百分位法,在2000多个跨靴子上复制2027种种子. 每个复制的复制品外观和参与者独立外观,根据复制品的计数结果来权衡每个评级,并将照片和条款附在外观上. 没有合格分母的复制则省略。 α\α复标的间隔以2027种子完成2,000次的外观块,保留每个块的所有项目,评分和缺失的响应,并固定评分面板.

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Tab. S7 , the mean score is close to “mostly matches”, with 68.94% of numeric ratings at least four. Chroma (4.19) and hue (4.09) clauses have the highest attribute-level means. Their skip rates of 44.15% and 33.93% reflect hues absent from some photographs. Across the eight clause templates, contrast has the highest mean and lowered-white-point clauses the lowest. Across eligible clause-rater units, 45.11% receive ratings of at least four on all three photographs. Ordinal α \alpha is 0.595. Look-level means pool numeric ratings from the five assigned raters, and their crossed bootstrap intervals incorporate variation across looks and raters.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如塔布所示. S7,平均分接近"大部分匹配",68.94%的数值收视率至少为4. Chroma(4.19)和hue(4.09)条款具有最高属性级手段。 他们的跳伞率分别为44.15%和33.93%,反映了一些照片中缺失的胡同. 在八个条款模板中,对比值最高,下白点条款最低。 在所有符合资格的条款 -- -- 比率单位中,所有三张照片的评级为至少四张。 官能团α-α为0.595. Look-level 表示来自五个指定测评人的池数评级,其跨度的靴子间隔包含着不同视差和测评人的差异.

blocks.en: Across the eight comparisons, a supervised variant gives the lowest error in seven, and AceTone gives the lowest error under Look S089, with 2.75 against 6.22 for the unedited input. Text style transfer gives the largest error in seven comparisons through painterly textures and broad color washes, reaching 48.44 for FastCLIPstyler under Look S089. Retouching agents stay closer to the input, but their errors vary across photographs. VeraRetouch reaches 4.26 under Look S021, below 6.80 for the unedited input, and 25.12 under Look S067, against 11.67. MonetGPT falls below the unedited input in four comparisons, although its CV mean in Tab. 1 in the main paper is higher than that of the unedited input. The same description can also produce different deviations on different photographs. Under Look S031, zero-shot StyleBooth has an error of 8.28 in Fig. S5 and 18.82 in Fig. S10 .
